title: DNF total influence bound
statement: For every DNF formula $d$ on $n$ Boolean variables, the total influence under the uniform measure of the sign encoding of its value is at most twice the width of $d$, where the width is the maximum term width and is $0$ for an empty formula.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a DNF formula on $n$ Boolean variables
replaced: For every DNF $d$ on $n$ variables, the total influence under the uniform cube law of $x\mapsto(-1)^{d(x)}$ is at most twice the width of $d$. For a real cube function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$ flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation, and $I(h)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}I_i(h)$.
